title: [TSA/TSB] Bug: Intermittent TSA/TSB test failures caused by FRR config apply latency
author: vishal-nokia
body:
### Is it platform specific

broadcom

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Most test cases in the TSA/TSB suite check the Traffic shift state by issuing TSC immediately after a TSA/TSB operation. However, due to some delay in the application of FRR config, TSC can report that the DUT is in inconsistent state leading to intermittent test failures.

Errors noticed when TSC is issued after TSB.
``` python
# code
linecard.shell('TSB')
linecard.shell('sudo config save -y')
# Ensure that the DUT is not in maintenance already before start of the test
pytest_assert(TS_NORMAL == get_traffic_shift_state(linecard, cmd='TSC no-stats'),
                          "DUT is not in normal state")
```
``` bash
# Error logs
>       pytest.fail("{} return unexpected state {}".format(cmd, "ERROR"))
E       Failed: TSC no-stats return unexpected state ERROR

cmd        = 'TSC no-stats'
host       = <MultiAsicSonicHost ixre-egl-board202>
outputs    = ['BGP0 : System Mode: Maintenance', 'BGP1 : System Mode: Normal']
```
Similar Errors when TSC is issued after TSA
``` python
# code
lc.shell('TSA')
lc.shell('sudo config save -y')
# Ensure that the DUT is in maintenance state
pytest_assert(TS_MAINTENANCE == get_traffic_shift_state(lc, cmd='TSC no-stats'),
                      "DUT is not in maintenance state")
```
``` bash
# Error logs
>       pytest.fail("{} return unexpected state {}".format(cmd, "ERROR"))
E       Failed: TSC no-stats return unexpected state ERROR

cmd        = 'TSC no-stats'
host       = <MultiAsicSonicHost ixre-egl-board202>
outputs    = ['BGP0 : System Mode: Not consistent', 'BGP1 : System Mode: Maintenance']
```

### Steps to Reproduce

The following script [test.sh](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22413608/test.sh) runs TSA-TSC-TSB-TSC in a loop. 
After running the script for 50 iterations, TSC reported incorrect state 2/5 times.

Adding a small delay(5s) between issuing TSA/TSB and TSC resolved the issue.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

TSC after TSB
Expected behavior:
``` 
['BGP0 : System Mode: Normal', 'BGP1 : System Mode: Normal']
```

Actual Behavior (Intermittent):
``` 
['BGP0 : System Mode: Maintenance', 'BGP1 : System Mode: Normal']
```

